=name= smashed a battalion of Sons and Daughters through a giant mainframe, showering the surrounding temple in glass and gallium.

In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= won a decisive victory against the combined Templar forces at the bloody Battle of Grit Gate. Grit Gate was so devasted by hot gallium and smashed glass that it was renamed Otho's Graveyard.

At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under a =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article= and meadowed sky, the hindren of Bey Lah saw an image on the horizon that looked like a great looking glass. It was =name=, and once =player.subjective= arrived, the hindren built a monument to =player.objective= and thenceforth called =player.objective= the Looking Glass Kendren.

Travel to the hidden village of Bey Lah and investigate the problems there.

You found the hindren pariah Eskhind and her sisters inside a hollowed out tree.
Remember! =name= admonished the pariah Eskhind for fleeing her destiny. Thenceforth she was known as Eskhind the Meek.

In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= was challenged by the accused Eskhind to a duel over the location of the hindren heirloom Kindrish. =name= won and admonished Eskhind into returning to Bey Lah.

How inspiring is the presence of =name=, who so redeemed Eskhind the Meek that she sought the hand of Bey Lah's greatest champion!
In the burnt out core of a tree stump, =name= cemented =player.possessive= friendship with the hindren of Bey Lah by marrying Eskhind and the Warden Neelahind.

Intervene before the fate of the lovers is sealed.

Give the crumpled sheet of paper to its author or intended recipient.

For better or worse to the fate of Bey Lah, you solved the mystery of Kindrish's disappearance and helped Warden Neelahind administer justice.
Hallowed savior! =name= brought peace and prosperity to the troubled deerfolk of the Bey Lah meadow.

Acting against thieves and the authorities who empower them, =name= led an investigation in the village of Bey Lah. Because of =player.t's= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= wit, the Warden Neelahind was able to properly administer justice.

Speak to Warden Neelahind with evidence of the event and accuse the thief that took Kindrish.
